paper_info.title: Consumer perception of price fairness and dynamic pricing

core_analysis.summary: Researchers scraped Booking.com hotel data and used the difference between value-for-money and overall ratings as a proxy for price fairness.
core_analysis.methodology: The study used Booking.com hotel data and customer ratings to measure perceived price fairness.

preprocess.normalized_text: Booking.com hotel data and the difference between value-for-money and overall ratings were used as a fairness proxy.
